title: ShinyHunters claims FBI data theft, demands bureau retract cyber warning
summary: The hacking group says it obtained sensitive employee and applicant records. The full scope of the claimed breach remains unclear.

title: FAA administrator defends withholding part of ATC pay raise
summary: Democrats on a House appropriations subcommittee accused FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford of trying to “squeeze” the already overstretched air traffic controller workforce.

title: Congress — not the president — should appoint the next GAO head, bipartisan coalition argues
summary: The organizations from across the political spectrum contended that former Comptroller General Gene Dodaro’s retirement last year provides an opportunity for lawmakers to overhaul the nomination process.

title: Trump wants an ‘AI Force.’ What would that actually look like?
summary: The president compared the proposed unit to Space Force, but offered few details about its mission, authority or place in the federal government.

title: IRS watchdog audits employee reassignments, as agency looks to extend some tours of duty
summary: Employees placed on these involuntary details are doing jobs several pay grades below the work they were hired to perform, but continue to receive their regular paychecks.

title: Lawmakers call on leadership to override Trump’s planned pay freeze
summary: Members of both parties urged congressional leaders to “at minimum” authorize an across-the-board 3.8% pay raise for civilian federal employees, in line with President Trump’s supplemental pay increase planned only for law enforcement.

title: OPM uses conservative influencers on college tour to recruit young workers
summary: On Thursday, the government HR agency chief is visiting an unaccredited college founded by right-wing figures.

title: A second lawsuit challenges plans to put ICE agents near polling places
summary: The filing comes after administration officials said federal agents could conduct immigration enforcement at polling locations in certain circumstances.

title: NASA employees: EEOC committed ‘flagrant distortions’ to decertify class complaint
summary: EEOC officials touted a long-running discrimination case against NASA as an example why federal sector cases were in need of reform. The employees who brought the case said commissioners railroaded them.

title: Labor’s disability accommodation delays under scrutiny by House lawmakers
summary: Lawmakers say interim accommodations “are infrequently considered,” and that staffing shortages have contributed to significant processing delays and growing backlogs.

title: Space Force braces for stalled progress amid lack of full funding
summary: Fiscal 2027 program starts are already on hold until December.

title: The FDA requires follow-up studies for drugs and devices. Years later, many still aren’t done
summary: An analysis of FDA data found hundreds of postmarket studies running behind schedule, raising questions about the agency’s ability to ensure manufacturers follow through.

title: Inside Commerce efforts to break data siloes and improve integrity
summary: An agency official also encouraged public comment on a proposed overhaul of the census that would eliminate race questions and change who is counted as living in the U.S.

title: VA disputes arbitration fees split with union it’s fighting to no longer recognize
summary: VA officials say the agency will pay a "portion" of what a third-party arbitrator billed it, but is "unable to pay” for services rendered when VA didn't officially recognize its largest union.

title: ICE chief nominee’s path to Senate confirmation ends abruptly
summary: Richard “Lance” Schroyer’s nomination had yet to reach a confirmation hearing before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee.

title: Interior watchdog clears official over agency work involving his former oil industry employer
summary: The inspector general for the Interior Department has faced scrutiny due to the installation of a political appointee in the office, but the watchdog’s former leader said that the outcome of this ethics investigation “seems legitimate.”

title: Navigating the Pay.gov maze for federal retirement deposits
summary: Don't let missing service credits or opaque OPM billing notices shrink your monthly annuity. Here is what you need to know before clicking submit.

title: AI ‘is changing the game’ in fraud threats and prevention efforts, SSA OIG official says
summary: Chief Strategy Officer for the SSA Office of the Inspector General Chad Bungard said “the government is looking towards AI to fight fraud, and the criminals are looking towards AI to commit fraud.”

title: Lawmakers again raise alarm over OPM’s health records collection plan
summary: The Office of Personnel Management’s plan to collect claims-level health information about federal workers and their family members and store it for 30 years could open feds up to a potential security breach, Senate Democrats said.

title: VA’s reported staffing challenges in healthcare facilities hit 7-year high
summary: An annual report from VA’s inspector general office highlights the types of positions VA healthcare facilities have difficulty filling when they need to hire, but “does not necessarily indicate the presence of vacancies.”

title: ‘I love to solve problems’: Awards program honors feds who improved the delivery of public services
summary: The Service to the Citizen award recognizes public servants at the federal, state and local levels as well as contractors.

title: TSA uses AI agent to respond to 100,000 traveler conversations per month
summary: The technology has resolved 96% of traveler inquiries without human escalation, according to Salesforce.
